etymologies.etymologyHTML: From earlier oversea, equivalent to oversea +‎ -s. Compare West Frisian oerseesk, Dutch overzees, German Übersee, Danish oversøisk.

definitions.definition: Used with ethnicities, nationalities, or religious affiliations: living (being resident) in a foreign country.
Across a sea; to or in an area across a sea.
Across a sea; to an area across a sea.

quote.citation: 1988, R.E.M. (lyrics and music), “Orange Crush”, in Green:
quote.text: I've had my fun and now it's time to send / Your conscience overseas / Coming in fast / Over me
